children: Tesco's shares are likely to respond positively after the U.K. grocer pushed the lower end of its adjusted operating profit guidance for its fiscal year, analysts at Bernstein say in a note. The company also increased its share buyback program for the year, further adding to the likelihood that shares will react well, they say, noting that Tesco had a profit beat with strong margins.
